newsitem.title: USA: AW Computer names McMullin as chairman.
newsitem.headline: AW Computer names McMullin as chairman.

text.p: AW Computer Systems Inc said Tuesday its board had elected Charles McMullin, the company's executive vice president, as chairman.
AW Computer, which provides point-of-sale system solutions to major retailers, said McMullin succeeds Nick Ambrus, who has retired.

It said the board also appointed as board members investment adviser Frank Cappiello, Mylan Laboratories Inc Vice President Patricia Sunseri, and Semcor President Vincent Vidasas. They replace Nick Ambrus, Mike Lutze and Robert Hannon, all of whom resigned.
